title: Exclusive Offer: 50% Off The Lever!
author: Team Zeteo
content:
There is a reckoning taking place. Amid the rise of political figures like New
York's Zohran Mamdani, Michigan's Abdul El-Sayed, and Colorado's Melat Kiros,
oligarch-funded party insiders are on the defensive - and they're spending
millions to ensure their preferred candidates come out on top in the midterm
elections.

No newsroom has done more to expose that effort than our friends at _**The
Lever**_**.**

For the last six years, _The Lever_ has built an award-winning investigative
newsroom dedicated to uncovering the hidden mechanics of power and finance in
American politics. At a moment like this, that reporting is indispensable.

Right now,_**The Lever**_**is offering** _**Zeteo**_**subscribers 50% off a**
_**Lever**_**membership forever** - giving you access to all of the
groundbreaking reporting and benefits of a paid _Lever_ subscription.

[Get The Lever With 50% Off Forever](https://www.levernews.com/50-off-the-
lever-for-zeteo-readers)

Furthermore, _The Lever_ has just launched the latest installments of their
award-winning and chart-topping podcast series, 'Master Plan.' The new season
traces the decades-long campaign to build an all-powerful presidency,
culminating in the Trump White House.

Paid subscribers get early access and bonus materials. **Do not miss out** -
you need to hear what they uncover in 'Master Plan' to understand our current

With this special deal,**for less than $1 a week** , you'll get...
